# Billing API

> Invoices and media assets.
> Second line.
> 3 endpoints across 2 services (billing, media).

Version 2.1.0. Servers: `https://api.example.com` (production).
Every endpoint is `POST` with a JSON request body (`Content-Type: application/json`) and answers JSON with HTTP status 200 (ok), 422 (invalid input), or 500 (server error). The response type is the same for all three statuses, so check the status, then read the body. Framework-generated errors (400, 405, 413, 415) use the envelope `{"error":{"code":"...","message":"..."}}`.

## Authentication

- **TokenAuth**: send header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Required by 1 endpoint: `POST /rpc/billing/list-invoices`.
- **SessionAuth**: send cookie `session=<token>`. Required by 1 endpoint: `POST /rpc/billing/list-invoices`.
- **KeyAuth**: send query parameter `api_key=<token>`. Required by 1 endpoint: `POST /rpc/media/get-asset`.

## billing

Invoice listing and history.

### POST /rpc/billing/list-invoices

Auth: TokenAuth, SessionAuth.

Request body `InvoiceQuery`:

- `limit` (`number`)
- `cursor` (`string`, optional): Opaque page cursor

Response `Page_Invoice` (status 200, 422, and 500):

- `items` (`Invoice[]`)
- `total` (`number`)

```bash
curl \
  -X POST "https://api.example.com/rpc/billing/list-invoices" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  --cookie "session=<token>" \
  -d '{"limit": 0}'
```

### POST /rpc/billing/list-invoices-legacy

Deprecated: Use billing.ListInvoices.

No request body.

Response `Page_Invoice` (status 200, 422, and 500):

- `items` (`Invoice[]`)
- `total` (`number`)

```bash
curl \
  -X POST "https://api.example.com/rpc/billing/list-invoices-legacy"
```

## media

### POST /rpc/media/get-asset

Auth: KeyAuth.

No request body.

Response `Asset` (status 200, 422, and 500):

- `id` (`string`)

```bash
curl \
  -X POST "https://api.example.com/rpc/media/get-asset?api_key=<token>"
```

## Types

### Asset

- `id` (`string`)

### Invoice

- `id` (`string`): Invoice id
- `amount` (`number`)
- `note` (`string`, optional, nullable): Optional note
- `paidAt` (`string`, nullable)

### InvoiceQuery

- `limit` (`number`)
- `cursor` (`string`, optional): Opaque page cursor

### Page_Invoice

- `items` (`Invoice[]`)
- `total` (`number`)
